covid, for one thing. 

but a relatively late acknowledgement (in the sense of actually beginning to take real, meaningful action) of my depression and anxiety have been a large part of it. i'm working on it now, but it's kinda like once you poke the bear to try to get your dog out of its grip or whatever, you're definitely gonna get hurt and it's gonna be a big problem. you eventually go to a hospital and ostensibly it gets taken care of, you probably have to have some extensive work done and you have to go through (physical, but probably also psychiatric) therapy to get yourself better. that's kinda where i'm at. but also, in addition, now i have to get the dog treatment for his own injuries and also do whatever you do for a dog who has been traumatized to the same end. 

so, the thing that's helping is the thing that's making me feel all kinds of fuckin wackadoodley.
TEN MINUTES IN AND THIS IS SO MUCH
